about: Hand verdicts from the 2026-09-28 machine audit of Medi's unresolved / on-hold word events (reviewer "Claude audit 2026-09-28"). Read by scripts/audit_vocab_unresolved.py, which turns them into source-bound patches in docs/data/word-bank-review.json. Bins: settled (kind = independent|helped|incorrect|recall_failure), not_counted (echo|repeat|grammar|clarification|not_this_word|quote|filler|farsi|form_not_on_list), no_evidence (tutor_audio_missing|transcript_unclear), open (question for Medi/Amal). "set" = extra overlay fields (word_key for an ambiguous catalog key, tense, attempt_target). Every entry can be overturned by Medi or Amal.
